verdict.what_is_wrong: The trace supports a substantial, temporary degradation on TCP traffic between the Java workload at 172.18.0.3 and the datastore at 172.18.0.10:27017: the fault slices show repeated retransmissions around 1.5–1.9% and roughly 70% fewer TCP segments, while Java threads spend much more time sleeping and little time in CPU or disk wait. The fault is on the shared Java↔datastore path; packet events cannot determine which endpoint interface or shared network segment caused it, so attributing the cause exclusively to Java would overstate the evidence.
